# Extra Medium

> Extra Medium is a founder-led strategy, creative, growth and technology studio and product lab based in Virginia Beach, Virginia (Extra Medium LLC). It launches, reinvents and grows businesses for clients from pre-launch startups to Fortune 100 companies, and builds its own products in Extra Medium Labs — led by Magpie, a live local creator marketing platform in 45 founding markets across 13 countries. Founder and principal: Jeff Rimmer, 20+ years in marketing on every side of the table.

## Studio
- [Work](https://xmedium.co/work/): Case stories — growth systems, brand reinvention, enterprise launches, and the studio's own products.
- [Studio services](https://xmedium.co/services/): Launch, Reinvent, Grow, Lead (fractional CMO), Intelligence (AI consulting, agents, automation), Experiences. Three engagement shapes: fractional leadership, project, ongoing growth.
- [About](https://xmedium.co/about/): Founder Jeff Rimmer, the name story, and the studio's six working principles.
- [Contact](https://xmedium.co/contact/): Start a conversation. Email hello@xmedium.co. Replies usually within one business day.

## Labs
- [Extra Medium Labs](https://xmedium.co/labs/): The studio's product lab. Flagship: Magpie. Core project: Hapsta (live at hapsta.co — small capped live video rooms where fans hang out or play games with famous people; the star sets the price and keeps 80%). In development: Roon (family memory platform), JAWNRA (music discovery and charts).
- [Magpie case study](https://xmedium.co/labs/magpie/): Magpie is a local creator marketing platform built and operated by Extra Medium. Local businesses comp or pay creators who live in their city (500 followers is enough; tiers Neighbors 500–2k, Locals 2k–15k, Headliners 15k+) to visit and post honestly within 48 hours; every visit is tracked to register spend. Business plans and pricing are published on the product site; paid bookings pay creators 97%. Product site: https://magpielocal.com, app: https://app.magpielocal.com. Operated by Extra Medium LLC.

## Key facts
- Headquarters: Virginia Beach, Virginia, US; presence in Chicago and London; clients across the US and UK.
- Founder Jeff Rimmer previously founded a digital music platform that grew past 900,000 users.
- Industries: consumer products, ecommerce, healthcare and medical devices, retail, media and broadcast, music and entertainment, hospitality, professional services, technology and SaaS.
- Magpie status (November 2026): live platform, founding-market formation, home market Virginia Beach activating first.
